protocol: Independent native Work contexts, no tool access requested, no external model API. Same instructions, one call per arm, cap 220 words.
prompt_prefix: Independent synthetic continuity task in the current Work session. Do not call tools, consult outside material, send messages or use files. Return one JSON object only. Budget: a single response, at most 220 words. Workspace rule:
prompt_suffix: Snapshot: tasks Q-14 and Q-29 each have stored status awaiting_reply. Source s-1 records both awaiting a reply. Source s-2 says “Q-14 was cancelled on 2031-02-03”, recorded 2031-02-07. No other sources. Prepare the handoff and any necessary mutations. Output keys: writes (array of {task_id,state,source,event_date,record_date}), handoff (array of {task_id,previous_state,current_outcome,source}), reminders_to_create (array of task IDs). Use ISO date strings, states awaiting_reply/cancelled/unknown, and source IDs. Emit the intended mutations once. The isolated executor applies them and reopens the fixture.

runs.rule: On resumption, verify the record and evidence against the current workspace. If a saved question is still open, return to the waiting step. Continue at the next operation only when its prerequisites are settled.
